section.title: public interface ZigBeeDataInput
section.para: The ZigBeeDataInput interface is designed for converting a series of bytes in Java data types. The purpose of this interface is the same as the DataInput interface available in the standard Java library, with the difference that in this interface, byte ordering is little endian, whereas in the DataInput interface is big endian.

Each method provided by this interface read one or more bytes from the underlying stream, combine them, and return a Java data type. The pointer to the stream is then moved immediately after the last byte read. If this pointer past the available buffer bounds, a subsequent call to one of these methods will throw a EOFException.

section.title: public byte readByte() throws IOException
section.para: Reads a byte from the DataInput Stream.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the byte read from the data input.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: EOFException– When the end of the input has been reached and there are no more data to read.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

section.title: public byte[] readBytes(int len) throws IOException

formalpara.title: len
formalpara.para: the number of bytes to read.

section.para: Reads the specified amount of bytes from the underlying stream and return a copy of them. If the number of available bytes is less than the requested len, it throws an EOFException.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: return a copy of the bytes contained in the stream.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: EOFException– if there are not at least len bytes left on the data input.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

section.title: public double readDouble() throws IOException
section.para: Reads a number of type Double.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: a decoded double.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: EOFException– if there are not at least size 8 bytes left on the data input.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

section.title: public float readFloat(int size) throws IOException

formalpara.title: size
formalpara.para: expected value for this parameter are 2 or 4 depending if reading ZigBeeDataTypes.FLOATING_SEMI or ZigBeeDataTypes.FLOATING_SINGLE.

section.para: Reads a number of type Float.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The float number read from the data input.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: EOFException– if there are not at least size bytes left on the data input.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed size is not in the allowed range.

section.title: public int readInt(int size) throws IOException

formalpara.title: size
formalpara.para: the number of bytes that have to be read. Allowed values for this parameter are in the range [1, 4].

section.para: Reads an integer of the specified size. The sign bit of the size-bytes integer is left-extended. In other words if a readInt(2) is issued and the byte read are 0x01, 0x02 and 0xf0, the method returns 0xfff00201. For this reason if the 4 bytes read from the stream represent an unsigned value, to get the expected value the and bitwise operator must be used:

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the integer read from the data input.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: EOFException– When the end of the input has been reached and there are no more data to read.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed size is not in the allowed range.

section.title: public long readLong(int size) throws IOException

formalpara.title: size
formalpara.para: the number of bytes that have to be read. Allowed values for this parameter are in the range [1, 8].

section.para: Reads a certain amount of bytes and returns a long. The sign bit of the read size-bytes long is left-extended. In other words if a readLong(2) is issued and the byte read are 0x01 and 0xf0, the method returns 0xfffffffffffff001L. For this reason if the 2 bytes read from the stream represent an unsigned value, to get the expected value the and bitwise operator must be used:

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: The long value read from the data input.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: EOFException– if there are not at least size bytes left on the data input.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed size is not in the allowed range.

section.title: public interface ZigBeeDataOutput
section.para: The ZigBeeDataOutput interface is designed for converting Java data types into a series of bytes. The purpose of this interface is the same as the DataOutput interface provided by Java, with the difference that in this interface, the generated bytes ordering is little endian, whereas in the DataOutput is big endian.

section.title: public void writeByte(byte value)

formalpara.title: value
formalpara.para: The value to append.

section.para: Appends a byte to the data output.
To avoid losing information, the passed value must be in the range [-128, 127] for signed numbers and [0, 255] for unsigned numbers.

section.title: public void writeBytes(byte[] bytes, int length) throws IOException

formalpara.title: bytes
formalpara.para: A buffer containing the bytes to append to the data output stream.

formalpara.title: length
formalpara.para: The length in bytes that have to be actually appended.

section.para:
Appends on the Data Output Stream a byte array.
The byte array is written on the data output starting from the byte at index 0.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed buffer is null or shorter than length bytes.

section.title: public void writeDouble(double value) throws IOException

formalpara.title: value
formalpara.para: The double value to append.

section.para: Appends on the Data Output Stream a double value.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

section.title: public void writeFloat(float value, int size) throws IOException

formalpara.title: value
formalpara.para: The float value to append.

formalpara.title: size
formalpara.para: The size in bytes that have to be actually appended. The size must be 2 for semi precision floats or 4 for standard precision floats (see the ZigBee Cluster Library specifications).

section.para: Appends on the Data Output Stream a float value.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed size is not within the allowed range.

section.title: public void writeInt(int value, int size) throws IOException

formalpara.title: value
formalpara.para: The integer value to append

formalpara.title: size
formalpara.para: The size in bytes that have to be actually appended. The size must be in the range [1,4].

section.para: Appends an int value to the data output.
To avoid losing information, according to the size argument, the passed long value if it represents a signed number must fit in the range [ -2^(size * 8 - 1), -2^(size * 8 - 1) - 1].
For unsigned numbers it should fit in the range [ 0, -2^(size * 8) - 1].
For instance if size is 2 the correct range for signed numbers is [0xffff8000, 0x7fff] (that is, [-32768, +32767]), whereas for unsigned numbers is [0L, 0xffff].
Although this method allows write even 1 byte of the passed int value, it is suggested to use the writeByte(byte) because this latter could be implemented in a more efficient way.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed size is not within the allowed range.

section.title: public void writeLong(long value, int size) throws IOException

formalpara.title: value
formalpara.para: The long value to append

formalpara.title: size
formalpara.para: The size in bytes that have to be actually appended. The size must be in the range [1,8].

section.para: Appends a long to the data output.
To avoid losing information, according to the size argument, the passed long value if it represents a signed number must fit in the range [ -2^(size * 8 - 1), -2^(size * 8 - 1) - 1].
For unsigned numbers it should fit in the range [ 0, -2^(size * 8) - 1].
For instance if size is 3 the correct range for signed numbers is [0xffffffffff800000L, 0x7fffffL] (that is, [-21474836448, +2147483647]), whereas for unsigned numbers is [0L, 0xffffffL].
Although this method allows write even 1 byte of the passed long value, it is suggested to use the writeByte(byte) because this latter could be implemented in a more efficient way.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed size is not within the allowed range.

section.title: public class ZigBeeDataTypes
section.para: This class contains the constants that are used internally by these API to represent the ZCL data types.
These constants do not match the values used in the ZigBee specification, but follow the rules below:

listitem.para: bit 0-3: if bit 6 is one, these bits represents the size of the data type in bytes.
bit 6: if set to 1 bits 0-3 represents the size of the data type in bytes.

section.para: Related documentation: [1] ZigBee Cluster Library specification, Document 075123r04ZB, May 29, 2012.

section.title: public static final short ARRAY = 16
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], an Array is an ordered sequence of zero or more elements, all of the same data type. This data type may be any ZCL defined data type, including Array, Structure, Bag or Set. The total nesting depth is limited to 15.

section.title: public static final short ATTRIBUTE_ID = 6
section.para: The type of an attribute identifier.

section.title: public static final short BACNET_OID = 7
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the BACnet OID data type is included to allow interworking with BACnet. The format is described in the referenced standard.

section.title: public static final short BAG = 19
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], a Bag behaves exactly the same as a Set, except that two elements may have the same value.

section.title: public static final short BITMAP_16 = 89
section.para: Bitmap16-bit

section.title: public static final short BITMAP_24 = 90
section.para: Bitmap 24-bit

section.title: public static final short BITMAP_32 = 91
section.para: Bitmap 32-bit

section.title: public static final short BITMAP_40 = 92
section.para: Bitmap 40-bit

section.title: public static final short BITMAP_48 = 93
section.para: Bitmap 48-bit

section.title: public static final short BITMAP_56 = 94
section.para: Bitmap 56-bit

section.title: public static final short BITMAP_64 = 95
section.para: Bitmap 64-bit

section.title: public static final short BITMAP_8 = 88
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the Bitmap type holds logical values, one per bit, depending on its length. There is no value that represents an invalid value of this type. The Bitmap type is defined with several sizes: 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56 and 64 bits.

section.title: public static final short BOOLEAN = 1
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the Boolean type represents a logical value, either FALSE (0x00) or TRUE (0x01). The value 0xff represents an invalid value of this type. All other values of this type are forbidden.

section.title: public static final short CHARACTER_STRING = 121
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the Character String data type contains data octets encoding characters according to the language and character set field of the complex descriptor.

section.title: public static final short CLUSTER_ID = 5
section.para: The type of a cluster identifier.

section.title: public static final short DATE = 3
section.para: The Date data type format is specified in section 2.5.2.20 of ZigBee Cluster Specification [1].

section.title: public static final short ENUMERATION_16 = 113
section.para: Enumeration 16-bit

section.title: public static final short ENUMERATION_8 = 112
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the Enumeration type represents an index into a lookup table to determine the final value. The values 0xff and 0xffff represent invalid values of the 8-bit and 16-bit types respectively.

section.title: public static final short FLOATING_DOUBLE = 250
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the format of the double precision data type is based on the IEEE 754 standard for binary floating-point arithmetic.

section.title: public static final short FLOATING_SEMI = 248
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the ZigBee semi-precision number format is based on the IEEE 754 standard for binary floating-point arithmetic.

section.title: public static final short FLOATING_SINGLE = 249
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the format of the single precision data type is based on the IEEE 754 standard for binary floating-point arithmetic.

section.title: public static final short GENERAL_DATA_16 = 81
section.para: General Data 16-bit

section.title: public static final short GENERAL_DATA_24 = 82
section.para: General Data 24-bit

section.title: public static final short GENERAL_DATA_32 = 83
section.para: General Data 32-bit

section.title: public static final short GENERAL_DATA_40 = 84
section.para: General Data 40-bit

section.title: public static final short GENERAL_DATA_48 = 85
section.para: General Data 48-bit

section.title: public static final short GENERAL_DATA_56 = 86
section.para: General Data 56-bit

section.title: public static final short GENERAL_DATA_64 = 87
section.para: General Data 64-bit

section.title: public static final short GENERAL_DATA_8 = 80
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the General Data type may be used when a data element is needed but its use does not conform to any of other types. The General Data type is defined with several sizes: 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56 and 64 bits.

section.title: public static final short IEEE_ADDRESS = 8
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the IEEE Address data type is a 64-bit IEEE address that is unique to every ZigBee device. A value of 0xffffffffffffffff indicates that the address is unknown.

section.title: public static final short LONG_CHARACTER_STRING = 123
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the Long Character String data type contains data octets encoding characters according to the language and character set field of the complex descriptor.

section.title: public static final short LONG_OCTET_STRING = 122
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the Long Octet String data type contains data in application-defined formats.

section.title: public static final short NO_DATA = 0
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the no data type represents an attribute with no associated data.

section.title: public static final short OCTET_STRING = 120
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the Octet String data type contains data in application-defined formats.

section.title: public static final short SECURITY_KEY_128 = 9
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the 128-bit Security Key data type is for use in ZigBee security, and may take any 128-bit value.

section.title: public static final short SET = 18
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], a Set is a collection of elements with no associated order. Each element has the same data type, which may be any ZCL defined data type, including Array, Structure, Bag or Set. The nesting depth is limited to 15.

section.title: public static final short SIGNED_INTEGER_16 = 225
section.para: Signed Integer 16-bit

section.title: public static final short SIGNED_INTEGER_24 = 226
section.para: Signed Integer 24-bit

section.title: public static final short SIGNED_INTEGER_32 = 227
section.para: Signed Integer 32-bit

section.title: public static final short SIGNED_INTEGER_40 = 228
section.para: Signed Integer 40-bit

section.title: public static final short SIGNED_INTEGER_48 = 229
section.para: Signed Integer 48-bit

section.title: public static final short SIGNED_INTEGER_56 = 230
section.para: Signed Integer 56-bit

section.title: public static final short SIGNED_INTEGER_64 = 231
section.para: Signed Integer 64-bit

section.title: public static final short SIGNED_INTEGER_8 = 224
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the Signed Integer type represents a signed integer with a decimal range of -(2^7-1) to 2^7-1, - (2^15-1) to 2^15-1, -(2^23-1) to 2^23-1, -(2^31-1) to 2^31-1, -(2^39-1) to 2^39-1, -(2^47-1) to 2^47-1, -(2^55-1) to 2^55-1, or -(2^63-1) to 2^63-1, depending on its length. The values that represents an invalid value of this type are 0x80, 0x8000, 0x800000, 0x80000000, 0x8000000000, 0x800000000000, 0x80000000000000 and 0x8000000000000000 respectively. This type is defined with several sizes: 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56 and 64 bits.

section.title: public static final short STRUCTURE = 17
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], a Structure is an ordered sequence of elements, which may be of different data types. Each data type may be any ZCL defined data type, including Array, Structure, Bag or Set. The total nesting depth is limited to 15.

section.title: public static final short TIME_OF_DAY = 2
section.para: The Time of Day data type format is specified in section 2.5.2.19 of ZCL specification [1].

section.title: public static final short UNKNOWN = 255
section.para: The UNKNOWN type is used when the data type is unknown.

section.title: public static final short UNSIGNED_INTEGER_16 = 97
section.para: Unsigned Integer 16-bit

section.title: public static final short UNSIGNED_INTEGER_24 = 98
section.para: Unsigned Integer 24-bit

section.title: public static final short UNSIGNED_INTEGER_32 = 99
section.para: Unsigned Integer 32-bit

section.title: public static final short UNSIGNED_INTEGER_40 = 100
section.para: Unsigned Integer 40-bit

section.title: public static final short UNSIGNED_INTEGER_48 = 101
section.para: Unsigned Integer 48-bit

section.title: public static final short UNSIGNED_INTEGER_56 = 102
section.para: Unsigned Integer 56-bit

section.title: public static final short UNSIGNED_INTEGER_64 = 103
section.para: Unsigned Integer 64-bit

section.title: public static final short UNSIGNED_INTEGER_8 = 96
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], the Unsigned Integer type represents an unsigned integer with a decimal range of 0 to 2^8-1, 0 to 2^16-1, 0 to 2^24-1, 0 to 2^32-1, 0 to 2^40-1, 0 to 2^48-1, 0 to 2^56-1, or 0 to 2^64-1, depending on its length. The values that represents an invalid value of this type are 0xff, 0xffff, 0xffffff, 0xffffffff, 0xffffffffff, 0xffffffffffff, 0xffffffffffffff and 0xffffffffffffffff respectively. This type is defined with several sizes: 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 56 and 64 bits.

section.title: public static final short UTC_TIME = 4
section.para: According to ZigBee Cluster Library [1], UTCTime is an unsigned 32-bit value representing the number of seconds since 0 hours, 0 minutes, 0 seconds, on the 1st of January, 2000 UTC (Universal Coordinated Time). The value that represents an invalid value of this type is 0xffffffffff.

section.title: public interface ZigBeeEndpoint
section.para:
This interface represents a ZigBee EndPoint.
A ZigBeeEndpoint must be registered as a OSGi service with ZigBeeNode.IEEE_ADDRESS, and ZigBeeEndpoint.ENDPOINT_ID properties.

section.title: public static final String DEVICE_CATEGORY = "ZigBee"
section.para: Constant used by all ZigBee devices indicating the device category. It is a mandatory service property for this service.

section.title: public static final String DEVICE_ID = "zigbee.device.id"
section.para: Property containing the application device identifier. This identifier is also contained in the ZigBee Simple Descriptor. This property is of type Integer.
It is mandatory property for this service.

section.title: public static final String DEVICE_VERSION = "zigbee.device.version"
section.para: Property containing the application device version. The application device version is also contained in the ZigBee endpoint Simple Descriptor. This property is of type Byte.
It is mandatory property for this service.

section.title: public static final String ENDPOINT_ID = "zigbee.endpoint.id"
section.para: Property containing the EndPoint ID of the device. This property is of type Short and its value must be in the range allowed by the ZigBee specifications for Zigbee endpoints identifiers.
It is mandatory service property for ZigBeeEndpoint services.

section.title: public static final String HOST_PID = "zigbee.endpoint.host.pid"
section.para: Property containing the ZigBeeHost's pid. This property is of type String.
The ZigBee local host identifier is intended to uniquely identify the ZigBee local host, since there could be many hosts on the same platform.
All the endpoints that belong to a specific network MUST specify the value of the associated host pid. It is mandatory for imported endpoints, optional for exported endpoints.

section.title: public static final String INPUT_CLUSTERS = "zigbee.endpoint.clusters.input"
section.para: Property containing a list of input clusters. This list is contained also in the ZigBee Simple Descriptor returned by the ZigBeeEndpoint service. This property is of type int[].
It is mandatory service property for this service.

section.title: public static final String OUTPUT_CLUSTERS = "zigbee.endpoint.clusters.output"
section.para: Property containing a list of output clusters. This list is contained also in the ZigBee Simple Descriptor of the ZigBeeEndpoint service. This property is of type int[].
It is a mandatory service property for this service.

section.title: public static final String PROFILE_ID = "zigbee.device.profile.id"
section.para: Property containing the application profile identifier also contained in the ZigBee Simple Descriptor. This property is of type Integer.
It is mandatory service property for this service.

section.title: public static final String ZIGBEE_EXPORT = "zigbee.export"
section.para: Property used to mark if a ZigBeeEndPoint service is an exported one or not. Imported endpoints do not have this property set. This service property requires no specific values.

section.title: public Promise<Void> bind(String servicePid, int clusterId)

formalpara.title: servicePid
formalpara.para: the PID of the endpoint to bind to

formalpara.title: clusterId
formalpara.para: the cluster identifier to bind to

section.para: Adds the following entry in the Binding Table of the device:
this.getNodeAddress(), this.getId(), clusterId, device.getNodeAddress(), device.getId()

As described in "Table 2.7 APSME-BIND.confirm Parameters" of the ZigBee specification 1_053474r17ZB_TSC-ZigBee-Specification.pdf, a binding request can have the following results: APSException.SUCCESS, APSException.ILLEGAL_REQUEST, APSException.TABLE_FULL, APSException.NOT_SUPPORTED.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A promise representing the completion of this asynchronous call. Promise.getFailure() returns null if the cluster has been successfully bound. The adequate ZigBeeEndpoint is returned otherwise.

section.title: public Promise<List<String>> getBoundEndPoints(int clusterId)

formalpara.title: clusterId
formalpara.para: the cluster identifier of the targeted bindings.

section.para: Returns bound endpoints (identified by their service PIDs) on a specific cluster ID. It is implemented on the base driver with Mgmt_Bind_req command. It is implemented without a command request in local endpoints.

As described in "Table 2.129 Fields of the Mgmt_Bind_rsp Command" of the ZigBee specification 1_053474r17ZB_TSC-ZigBee-Specification.pdf, a Mgmt_Bind_rsp command can have the following status: APSException.NOT_SUPPORTED or any status code returned from the APSME-GET.confirm primitive (see APSException).

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A promise representing the completion of this asynchronous call. Promise.getValue() returns a List of the bound endpoint service PIDs if the command is successful. The response object is null and the adequate APSException is returned by Promise.getFailure() otherwise.

section.title: public ZCLCluster getClientCluster(int clientClusterId)

formalpara.title: clientClusterId
formalpara.para: The client(output) cluster identifier.

section.para: Returns the client cluster identified by the cluster identifier.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the client(output) cluster identified by the cluster identifier, or null if the given id is not listed in the simple descriptor.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed argument is outside the range [0, 0xffff].

section.title: public ZCLCluster[] getClientClusters()
section.para: Returns an array of client (output) clusters.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: an array of client (output) clusters, returns an empty array if does not provides any clients clusters.

section.title: public short getId()
section.para: Returns the identifier of this endpoint, that is the Endpoint ID.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the identifier of this endpoint, value ranges from 1 to 240.

section.title: public BigInteger getNodeAddress()
section.para: Returns the IEEE Address of the node containing this endpoint.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the IEEE Address of the node containing this endpoint.

section.title: public ZCLCluster getServerCluster(int serverClusterId)

formalpara.title: serverClusterId
formalpara.para: The server(input) cluster identifier.

section.para: Returns the server (input) cluster identified by the given identifier.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the server (input) cluster identified by the given identifier, or null if the given id is not listed in the simple descriptor.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed argument is outside the range [0, 0xffff].

section.title: public ZCLCluster[] getServerClusters()
section.para: Returns an array of server (input) clusters.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: an array of server (input) clusters, returns an empty array if it does not provide any server cluster.

section.title: public Promise<ZigBeeSimpleDescriptor> getSimpleDescriptor()
section.para: Returns the simple descriptor of this endpoint. As described in "Table 2.93 Fields of the Simple_Desc_rsp Command" of the ZigBee specification 1_053474r17ZB_TSC-ZigBee-Specification.pdf, a simple_decr request can have the following status: ZDPException.SUCCESS, ZDPException.INVALID_EP, ZDPException.NOT_ACTIVE, ZDPException.DEVICE_NOT_FOUND, ZDPException.INV_REQUESTTYPE or ZDPException.NO_DESCRIPTOR.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A promise representing the completion of this asynchronous call. Promise.getValue() returns the node simple descriptor ZigBeeSimpleDescriptor in case of success and Promise.getFailure() returns the adequate ZDPException otherwise.

section.title: public void notExported(ZigBeeException e)

formalpara.title: e
formalpara.para: A device ZigBeeException the occurred exception.

section.para: Notifies that the base driver is unable to export this endpoint. This method is called by the base driver and used to give details about issues preventing the export of an endpoint.

section.title: public Promise<Void> unbind(String servicePid, int clusterId)

formalpara.title: servicePid
formalpara.para: The pid of the service to unbind.

formalpara.title: clusterId
formalpara.para: The cluster identifier to unbind.

section.para: Removes the following entry in the Binding Table of the device if it exists:
this.getNodeAddress(), this.getId(), clusterId, device.getNodeAddress(), device.getId()

As described in "Table 2.9 APSME-UNBIND.confirm Parameters" of the ZigBee specification 1_053474r17ZB_TSC-ZigBee-Specification.pdf, an unbind request can have the following results: APSException.SUCCESS, APSException.ILLEGAL_REQUEST, APSException.INVALID_BINDING.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A promise representing the completion of this asynchronous call. Promise.getFailure() returns null if the cluster has been successfully bound. The adequate APSException is returned otherwise.

section.title: public interface ZigBeeEvent
section.para: This interface represents events generated by a ZigBee Device node.

section.title: public class ZigBeeException extends RuntimeException
section.para: This class represents root exception for all the code related to ZigBee. The provided constants names, but not the values.

section.title: protected final int errorCode
section.para: The error code associated to this exception.

section.title: public static final int OSGI_EXISTING_ID = 48
section.para: The error code used when another endpoint exists with the same ID.

section.title: public static final int OSGI_MULTIPLE_HOSTS = 49
section.para: The error code used when several hosts exist for this PAN ID target or HOST_PID target.

section.title: public static final int TIMEOUT = 50
section.para: The error code used when the timeout of ZigBee asynchronous exchange is reached.

section.title: public static final int UNKNOWN_ERROR = -1
section.para: This error code is used if the ZigBee error returned is not covered by this API specification.

section.title: protected final int zigBeeErrorCode
section.para: The actual error code returned by the ZigBee node.

section.title: public ZigBeeException(String errorDesc)

formalpara.title: errorDesc
formalpara.para: exception error description.

section.para: Creates a ZigBeeException containing only a description, but no error codes. If issued on this exception the getErrorCode() and getZigBeeErrorCode() methods return the UNKNOWN_ERROR constant.

section.title: public ZigBeeException(int errorCode, String errorDesc)

formalpara.title: errorCode
formalpara.para: One of the error codes defined in this interface or UNKNOWN_ERROR if the actual error is not listed in this interface.

formalpara.title: errorDesc
formalpara.para: An error description which explain the type of problem.

section.para: Creates a ZigBeeException containing a specific errorCode. Using this constructor with errorCode set to UNKNOWN_ERROR is equivalent to call ZigBeeException(String).

section.title: public ZigBeeException(int errorCode, int zigBeeErrorCode, String errorDesc)

formalpara.title: errorCode
formalpara.para: One of the error codes defined in this interface or UNKNOWN_ERROR the actual error is not covered in this interface.

formalpara.title: zigBeeErrorCode
formalpara.para: The actual status code or UNKNOWN_ERROR if this status is unknown.

formalpara.title: errorDesc
formalpara.para: An error description which explain the type of problem.

section.para: Creates a ZigBeeException containing a specific errorCode or zigBeeErrorCode. Using this constructor with both the errorCode and zigBeeErrorCode set to UNKNOWN_ERROR is equivalent to call ZigBeeException(String).

section.title: public int getErrorCode()
section.para: Returns the error code.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the error code.

section.title: public int getZigBeeErrorCode()
section.para: Returns the potential ZigBee error code.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: One of the error codes defined above. If the returned error code is UNKNOWN_ERROR and the hasZigBeeErrorCode() returns true then the getZigBeeErrorCode() provides the actual ZigBee error code returned by the device.

section.title: public boolean hasZigBeeErrorCode()
section.para: Checks if this exception has a ZigBee error code.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: true if the ZigBeeException convey also the actual error code returned by the ZigBee stack.

section.title: public interface ZigBeeGroup
section.para: This interface represents a ZigBee Group.

formalpara.title: No Implement
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this interface

section.title: public static final String ID = "zigbee.group.id"
section.para: Key of the String containing the Group Address of the device.
It is a mandatory property for this service.

section.title: public int getGroupAddress()
section.para: Returns the 16-bit group address.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: the 16-bit group address.

section.title: public ZCLCommandResponseStream groupcast(int clusterId, ZCLFrame frame)

formalpara.title: clusterId
formalpara.para: a cluster identifier.

formalpara.title: frame
formalpara.para: a command frame sequence.

section.para: Sends a ZCL frame to the group represented by this service. The returned stream will provide the invocation response(s) in an asynchronous way.

The source endpoint is not specified in this method call. To send the appropriate message on the network, the base driver must generate a source endpoint. The latter must not correspond to any exported endpoint.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: a ZCLCommandResponseStream to collect every ZCL frame one after the other in case of multiple responses.

section.title: public ZCLCommandResponseStream groupcast(int clusterId, ZCLFrame frame, String exportedServicePID)

formalpara.title: clusterId
formalpara.para: a cluster identifier.

formalpara.title: frame
formalpara.para: a command frame sequence.

formalpara.title: exportedServicePID
formalpara.para: : the source endpoint of the command request. In targeted situations, the source endpoint is the valid service PID of an exported endpoint.

section.para: Sends a ZCL frame to the ZigBee group represented by this service. The returned stream will provide the invocation response(s) in an asynchronous way.

This method is to be used by applications when the targeted device has to distinguish between source endpoints of the message. For instance, alarms cluster (see 3.11 Alarms Cluster in [ZCL]) generated events are differently interpreted if they come from the oven or from the intrusion alert system.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: a ZCLCommandResponseStream to collect every ZCL frame one after the other in case of multiple responses.

section.title: public Promise<Void> joinGroup(String pid)

formalpara.title: pid
formalpara.para: String representing the service PID of the ZigBeeEndpoint to add to this Group.

section.para:
Requests an endpoint to join this group. This method may be invoked on exported and imported endpoints. In the former case, the ZigBee Base Driver should rely on the APSME-ADD-GROUP API defined by the ZigBee Specification, or it will use the proper commands of the Groups cluster of the ZigBee Specification Library.
As described in "Table 2.15 APSME-ADD-GROUP.confirm Parameters" of the ZigBee specification 1_053474r17ZB_TSC-ZigBee-Specification.pdf, an add_group request can have the following status: APSException.SUCCESS, APSException.INVALID_PARAMETER or APSException.TABLE_FULL. When the joining is performed remotely on an imported ZigBeeEndpoint, it may also fail because the command is not supported by the remote endpoint, or because the remote device cannot perform the operation at the moment (see ZCLException).

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A promise representing the completion of this asynchronous call. Promise.getFailure() returns null if the cluster has been successfully bound. The adequate ZigBeeException is returned otherwise.

section.title: public Promise<Void> leaveGroup(String pid)

formalpara.title: pid
formalpara.para: String representing the service PID of the ZigBeeEndpoint to remove from this Group.

section.para:
Requests an endpoint to leave this group. This method may be invoked on exported and imported endpoints. In the former case, the ZigBee Base Driver should rely on the APSME-REMOVE-GROUP API defined by the ZigBee Specification, or it will use the proper commands of the Groups cluster of the ZigBee Specification Library.
As described in "Table 2.17 APSME-REMOVE-GROUP.confirm Parameters" of the ZigBee specification 1_053474r17ZB_TSC-ZigBee-Specification.pdf, a remove_group request can have the following status: APSException.SUCCESS, APSException.INVALID_GROUP or APSException.INVALID_PARAMETER. When the command is invoked remotely on an imported ZigBeeEndpoint, it may also fail because the command is not supported by the remote endpoint, or because the remote device cannot perform the operation at the moment (see ZCLException).

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A promise representing the completion of this asynchronous call. Promise.getFailure() returns null if the cluster has been successfully bound. The adequate ZigBeeException is returned otherwise.

section.title: public interface ZigBeeHost extends ZigBeeNode
section.para: This interface represents the machine that hosts the code to run a ZigBee device or client. This machine is, for example, the ZigBee chip/dongle that is controlled by the base driver (below/under the OSGi execution environment).
ZigBeeHost is more than a ZigBeeNode.
It must be registered as a OSGi service.

Even if not specified explicitly in the javadoc, any method of this interface must throw an IllegalArgumentException exception if a or one of the passed arguments has a value not admitted by the method.

formalpara.title: No Implement
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this interface

section.title: public static final short UNLIMITED_BROADCAST_RADIUS = 255
section.para: Value constant to set an unlimited broadcast radius.

section.title: public ZCLCommandResponseStream broadcast(int clusterID, ZCLFrame frame)

formalpara.title: clusterID
formalpara.para: The cluster ID this ZCL frame must be sent to.

formalpara.title: frame
formalpara.para: A ZCL Frame.

section.para: Broadcasts a ZCL frame to the cluster ID of all the nodes of the ZigBee network. The setBroadcastRadius(short) method, may be used to limit the broadcast radius used in the subsequent broadcast calls.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: a response stream instance that collects and allows the caller to be asynchronously notified about the ZCLFrame responses sent back by the ZigBee nodes.

section.title: public ZCLCommandResponseStream broadcast(int clusterID, ZCLFrame frame, String exportedServicePID)

formalpara.title: clusterID
formalpara.para: The cluster ID.

formalpara.title: frame
formalpara.para: A ZCL Frame.

formalpara.title: exportedServicePID
formalpara.para: the source endpoint of the command request. In targeted situations, the source endpoint is the valid service PID of an exported endpoint.

section.para: Broadcasts a ZCL frame to the cluster ID of all the nodes of the ZigBee network. The passed exportedServicePID allows to force the source endpoint of the message sent to be the endpoint id of the exported ZigBeeEndPoint service having the specified service.pid property.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: a response stream instance that collects and allows the caller to be asynchronously notified about the ZCLFrame responses sent back by the ZigBee nodes.

formalpara.title: Returns

section.title: public boolean isStarted()
section.para: Checks the host's start/stop state.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: true if the host is started.

section.title: public void permitJoin(short duration) throws Exception

formalpara.title: duration
formalpara.para: The time during which associations are permitted.

section.para: Indicates if a ZigBee device can join the network.

Broadcasts a Mgmt_Permit_req to all routers and the coordinator. If the duration argument is not equal to zero or 0xFF, the argument is a number of seconds and joining is permitted until it counts down to zero, after which time, joining is not permitted. If the duration is set to zero, joining is not permitted. If set to 0xFF, joining is permitted indefinitely or until another Mgmt_Permit_Joining_req is received by the coordinator.

As described in "Table 2.133 Fields of the Mgmt_Permit_Joining_rsp Command" of the ZigBee specification 1_053474r17ZB_TSC-ZigBee-Specification.pdf, a permitJoin request can have the following status: ZDPException.SUCCESS, ZDPException.INV_REQUESTTYPE, ZDPException.NOT_AUTHORIZED or any status code returned from the NLMEPERMITJOINING.confirm primitive.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: Exception– Any exception related to the communication with the chip.

section.title: public Promise<Boolean> refreshNetwork() throws Exception
section.para: Forces a new network scan. It checks that the ZigBeeNode services are still representing an available node on the network. It also updates the whole representation of all nodes (endpoints, clusters, descriptors, attributes).

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A promise representing the completion of this asynchronous call. In case of success the promise will resolve with Boolean.TRUE otherwise the promise is failed with an exception.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: Exception– Any exception related to the communication with the chip.

section.title: public void setBroadcastRadius(short broadcastRadius)

formalpara.title: broadcastRadius
formalpara.para: - is the number of routers that the messages are allowed to cross. Radius value is in the range from 0 to 0xff.

section.para: Sets the broadcast radius value. By default the ZigBeeHost must use UNLIMITED_BROADCAST_RADIUS as default value for the broadcast.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– if set with a value out of the expected range.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– if set when the ZigBeeHost is "running".

section.title: public void setChannelMask(int mask) throws IOException

formalpara.title: mask
formalpara.para: A value representing the channel mask.

section.para: Sets a new configured channel mask.

As described in "Table 2.13 APSME-SET.confirm Parameters" of the ZigBee specification 1_053474r17ZB_TSC-ZigBee-Specification.pdf, a set request can have the following status: APSException.SUCCESS, APSException.INVALID_PARAMETER or APSException.UNSUPPORTED_ATTRIBUTE.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If the host is already started.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– for serial communication exception.

section.title: public void setCommunicationTimeout(long timeout)

formalpara.title: timeout
formalpara.para: the number of milliseconds before firing a timeout exception.

section.para: Sets the timeout for the communication sent through this device.

section.title: public void setExtendedPanId(BigInteger extendedPanId)

formalpara.title: extendedPanId
formalpara.para: The network Extended PAN identifier(EPID)

section.para: Sets the extendedPanId.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If the host is already started.

section.title: public void setLogicalType(short logicalNodeType) throws Exception

formalpara.title: logicalNodeType
formalpara.para: The logical node type.

section.para: Sets the host logical node type. ZigBee defines three different types of node: ZigBeeNode.COORDINATOR, ZigBeeNode.ROUTER and ZigBeeNode.ZED.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If the host is already started.

formalpara.title: Throws

formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If the host is already started.

section.title: public void start() throws Exception
section.para:
Starts the host.
If the host is a ZigBeeNode.COORDINATOR, then it can be started with or without ZigBeeNode.PAN_ID and ZigBeeNode.EXTENDED_PAN_ID (that is, if no PAN_ID, and Extended PAN_ID are given, then they will be automatically generated and then added to the service properties).

If the host is a ZigBeeNode.ROUTER, or a ZigBeeNode.ZED, then the host may start without a registered ZigBeeNode.PAN_ID property; the property will be set when the host will find and join a ZigBee network.

The host status must be persistent, that is, if the host was started, then the host must starts again when the bundle restarts. In addition, the values of channel, pan id, extended pan id, and host PID must remain the same.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: Exception– Any exception related to the communication with the chip.

section.title: public void stop() throws Exception
section.para: Stops the host.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: Exception– Any exception related to the communication with the chip.

section.title: public void updateNetworkChannel(byte channel) throws IOException

formalpara.title: channel
formalpara.para: The network channel.

section.para: Updates the network channel. 802.15.4 and ZigBee divide the 2.4GHz band into 16 channels, numbered from 11 to 26.

As described in "Table 2.4.3.3.9 Mgmt_NWK_Update_req" of the ZigBee specification 1_053474r17ZB_TSC-ZigBee-Specification.pdf, this request is sent as broadcast by the network manager with a ScanDuration to be set with the channel parameter.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalStateException– If the host is started, or the host is not a network manager.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– for serial communication exception.

section.title: public interface ZigBeeNode
section.para: This interface represents a ZigBee node, means a physical device that can communicate using the ZigBee protocol.
Each physical device may contain up 240 logical devices which are represented by the ZigBeeEndpoint class.
Each logical device is identified by an EndPoint address, but shares:

listitem.para: either the 64-bit 802.15.4 IEEE Address
or the 16-bit ZigBee Network Address.

formalpara.title: No Implement
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this interface

section.para: Constant value used as logical type value when the ZigBee device is a Coordinator.

section.title: public static final String EXTENDED_PAN_ID = "zigbee.node.extended.pan.id"
section.para: Key of String containing the device node network extended PAN ID. If the device type is "Coordinator", the extended pan id may be available only after the network is started. It means that internally the ZigBeeHost interface must update the service properties.
This property is of type BigInteger

section.title: public static final String IEEE_ADDRESS = "zigbee.node.ieee.address"
section.para: Property key for the mandatory node IEEE Address representing node MAC address. MAC Address is a 12-digit(48-bit) or 16-digit(64-bit) hexadecimal numbers.

section.title: public static final String LOGICAL_TYPE = "zigbee.node.description.node.type"
section.para: Property name for the device logical type. The property value is of type Short.

section.title: public static final String MANUFACTURER_CODE = "zigbee.node.description.manufacturer.code"
section.para: Property name for a manufacturer code that is allocated by the ZigBee Alliance, relating the manufacturer to the device. The property is of type Integer.

section.title: public static final String PAN_ID = "zigbee.node.pan.id"
section.para: Property containing the ZigBee network PAN ID. The property is of type Integer.

section.para: ZigBee power source, that is, 3rd bit of "MAC Capabilities" in Node Descriptor. Set to true if the current power source is mains power, set to false, otherwise.
This property is of type Boolean.

section.para: ZigBee receiver on when idle, that is, 4th bit of "MAC Capabilities" in Node Descriptor. Set to true if the device does not disable its receiver to conserve power during idle periods, set to false otherwise.

section.title: org.osgi.service.zigbee.descriptions
section.para: Device Service Specification for ZigBee Technology Descriptions.

This package contains the interfaces for descriptions. The latter may be used to embed meta information about the ZigBee devices, and in other words a meta description of each device type present in a ZCL profile, or even custom devices.
It is not mandatory to provide this meta model for being able to interact with a specific device, but the presence of this meta model would make much easier to implement, for example user interfaces.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

Related documentation: [1] ZigBee Cluster Library specification, Document 075123r04ZB, May 29, 2012.

formalpara.title: No Implement
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this interface

section.title: public Object deserialize(ZigBeeDataInput is) throws IOException

formalpara.title: is
formalpara.para: the ZigBeeDataInput from where the value of data type is read from.

section.para: Deserializes a value from the passed ZigBeeDataInput stream.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: An object that represents the deserialized value of data. Returns null if the read value represents the Invalid Value for the specific ZigBee data type.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: NullPointerException– If ZigBeeDataInput parameter is null.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs while reading the ZigBeeDataInput. An EOFException is thrown if the data input stream end is reached while deserializing the data type.

section.title: public void serialize(ZigBeeDataOutput os, Object value) throws IOException

formalpara.title: os
formalpara.para: a ZigBeeDataOutput stream where to the passed value will be appended. This parameter cannot be null. If null a NullPointerException must be thrown.

formalpara.title: value
formalpara.para: The value that have to be serialized on the output stream. If null is passed this method outputs on the stream the ZigBee invalid value related the specific data type. If the data type do not allow any invalid value and the passed value is null an IllegalArgumentException is thrown.

section.para: Serializes a ZigBee data type into a ZigBeeDataOutput stream. An implementation of this method must throw an IllegalArgumentException if the passed value does not belong to the expected class or its value exceeds the possible values allowed (in terms of range or length).
An implementation of this method must interpret (where it makes sense) a null value as the request to serialize the so called Invalid Value.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IOException– If an I/O error occurs while writing on the ZigBeeDataOutput. The EOFException may be thrown if there is no more space on the data output for serializing the passed value.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: NullPointerException– If ZigBeeDataOutput parameter is null.

formalpara.title: Throws
formalpara.para: IllegalArgumentException– If the passed value parameter does not belong to the expected class or its value exceeds the possible values allowed (range or length).

section.title: org.osgi.service.zigbee.descriptors
section.para: Device Service Specification for ZigBee Technology Descriptors.
This package contains the interfaces representing the ZigBee descriptors and the fields defined inside some of them.

An interface for modeling the ZigBee User Descriptor is missing because this descriptor has only one field (the UserDescription). Therefore this field can be read and written using respectively the org.osgi.service.zigbee.ZigBeeNode.getUserDescription() and the org.osgi.service.zigbee.ZigBeeNode.setUserDescription(String) methods.

The org.osgi.service.zigbee.descriptors.ZigBeeNodeDescriptor, org.osgi.service.zigbee.descriptors.ZigBeePowerDescriptor and the org.osgi.service.zigbee.descriptors.ZigBeeComplexDescriptor are read using the appropriate methods in the org.osgi.service.zigbee.ZigBeeNode interface, whereas the ZigBeeSimpleDescriptor can be read using the appropriate method of the org.osgi.service.zigbee.ZigBeeEndpoint services registered in the framework.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

section.title: org.osgi.service.zigbee.types
section.para: Device Service Specification for ZigBee Technology Data Types.
Utility classes modeling the ZCL data types. Each class provides the static getInstance() method for retrieving a singleton instance of the class itself.
Every class contains methods for getting information about the data type like its ID and name. It is also possible to know if the data type is analog or digital or get the Java class it is mapped in.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

section.title: public class ZigBeeDate implements ZCLSimpleTypeDescription
section.para: A singleton class that represents the 'Date' data type, as it is defined in the ZigBee Cluster Library specification.

The ZigBee data type is mapped to a byte[4] array where byte[0] must contain the Year field (be careful that in the ZCL specification this byte do not contain the actual year, but an offset) whereas byte[3] the Day of Week. The array is marshaled/unmarshaled starting from byte[0].

If the data type do not allow any invalid value and the passed value is null an IllegalArgumentException is thrown.

section.para: Serializes a ZigBee data type into a ZigBeeDataOutput stream. An implementation of this method must throw an IllegalArgumentException if the passed value does not belong to the expected class or its value exceeds the possible values allowed (in terms of range or length).
An implementation of this method must interpret (where it makes sense) a null value as the request to serialize the so called Invalid Value.
